object_description: compact volume of an east-side head building and a shed-roofed gymnasium body
design_condition: the compact structure fits into the orthogonal basic pattern of the existing complex and reinforces the visual axis between church and wooded hill, appearing discreetly at the village entrance

positive: The compact structure fits into the orthogonal basic pattern of the existing school complex
It appears discreetly at the village entrance and lets the church tower keep its effect
The existing visual axis remains and is strengthened by the setting of the new volume
A sequence of tree canopies along this axis defines three spatially separated break rooms
A spacious break area creates an appropriate distance from the private properties to the east
The three functional units of the front building are independent of each other via a staircase
The entrance area has a direct visual connection to the halls and the break area
The workrooms are accessed via a central cloakroom area and are illuminated on two sides
The equipment room at the front is accessible from both gymnasiums
The volume appears very compact with an appropriate structure from the cantilevered upper floor
The differentiation of the roof shapes of head building and gymnasium is appropriate
Head building and gymnasium are never higher than two floors
The three-sided windows in the gymnasium allow pleasant visual references to the landscape
The workrooms on the upper floor are well lit and sensibly developed
Their upper floor location means no disruption to school operations from the break area
Sharing the material rooms brings operational advantages
The compactness and a plan that dispenses with pure circulation enable very economical construction
This project can be expected to have the lowest construction costs
The project impresses with its local setting and its volumetric appearance
negative: There is no information about the facade material
The viewing gallery in the entrance area is rather small
The interior organisation of the gymnasium cloakrooms in the basement is not very attractive
The access areas there are too small with no adequate connection between stairs and gymnasiums
Functional limitations would raise the overall volume and construction costs in further processing
Locating the building on the line of the kindergarten severely limits views and lighting of the outdoor space
The structure of the outdoor spaces has potential but the design is difficult to read
The reduced volume imposes restrictions on the usability of the kindergarten building
